checked_claims.claim: Frozen disk observation and strict-floor math
checked_claims.evidence: 19,175,731,200 / 102,417,174,528 = 18.723% to three decimals. Strictly exceeding total/5 requires 20,483,434,906 integer available bytes; the resulting deficit is 1,307,703,706 bytes.
1,307,703,706 + 1,073,741,824 + 67,108,864 = 2,448,554,394 bytes. The 28 proposed directory estimates total 2,231,140,352 bytes, leaving an exact 217,414,042-byte shortfall.

The proposal enumerates only observed October 02-14 release directories and explicitly excludes Library09b19cc, failedReader17be4ce, every October15+ release, backups, current/rollback files, secrets, PVC, frozen inputs, loaded images, and unrelated resources.

ARCHIVE_OFFLOAD_20261015 is limited to eight copied regular image tar files and refuses directories. COUNTRY483 capacity worker is a separate pinned backup-alias plan using historical current63 assumptions. Neither source authorizes this current64 directory-tree proposal.
The inventory gives top-level observations only. Neither it nor the proposal establishes the cause of global disk growth.

limitations: Directory-level allocated-byte estimates are not fresh payload fingerprints and do not prove reclaimable bytes.
